_description: Viral RNA in CCLE RNA-seq: reads that did not map to the human genome, matched by 25-mers to 18 viral (and one mycoplasma) genomes. scanned = unmapped reads examined; per virus: reads, rpm (reads per million unmapped reads scanned), breadth (share of 50 genome bins covered), detected (reads >= 5, rpm >= 10, breadth >= 0.2), level (strong: rpm >= 1000, moderate: >= 300, low: below; low can be carry-over from another library on the same run). Undetected viruses are listed only with 3+ reads over 3+ bins.
modeNote: A sample: the last 25 MB of each file, about 330,000 unmapped reads per cell line. Strongly expressed viruses are found; a weak signal can be missed.
source: Computed for Correlate from the public DepMap CCLE RNA-seq BAMs, hg19 and hg38 (s3://depmap-omics-ccle); references from NCBI RefSeq.

HBV.label: Hepatitis B virus
HBV.note: Reference is genotype D (ayw); genotypes common in East Asia (B, C) differ by up to 8%, so exact 25-mer matching misses many of those infections.

HPV16.label: Human papillomavirus 16
HPV16.note: Only HPV16, 18 and 45 are in the panel; other HPV types are not detected.

HPV18.label: Human papillomavirus 18
HPV18.note: Only HPV16, 18 and 45 are in the panel; other HPV types are not detected.

HPV45.label: Human papillomavirus 45
HPV45.note: Only HPV16, 18 and 45 are in the panel; other HPV types are not detected.

SV40.label: Simian virus 40
SV40.note: SV40 promoter and polyA signals are in many plasmid vectors; a hit confined to those regions is a vector, not an infection (check breadth).

HAdV5.label: Human adenovirus 5
HAdV5.note: HEK293-derived and adenovirus-transformed lines carry adenovirus 5 DNA.

XMRV.label: XMRV (mouse retrovirus)
XMRV.note: Culture contaminant from mouse xenograft passage; shares sequence with MoMLV.

MLV.label: Moloney murine leukemia virus
MLV.note: Also the backbone of retroviral vectors (LTRs); a narrow hit can be a vector.

Mhyo.label: Mycoplasma hyorhinis
Mhyo.note: Culture contaminant. Bacterial mRNA has no polyA tail, so polyA-selected RNA-seq undercounts it; presence is informative, absence is weak evidence.
